pairs.target: liǎngtiān hòu dào liànxí jiān , tǎ wéi xiān kànjiàn mǐlā zhàn zài ménbiān , shǒulǐ ná zhe zhǐ , wéi lǎoshī zhèng ràng tā bǎ shàng huí huà de mù jiǎo zhǐ gěi sòng yuǎn kàn .
pairs.english: Two days later at the practice room, Tavi first saw Mira standing by the door with paper in hand; Instructor Vey was having her point out the wooden corner drawn last time for Song Yuan to see.
pairs.hanzi: 两天后到练习间，塔维先看见米拉站在门边，手里拿着纸，维老师正让她把上回画的木角指给宋远看。

pairs.target: tā qiányìtiān lái wèn guò néng bunéng kàn kōng mù tuō , wéi lǎoshī dāying liú yìxiǎo duàn gōngfū , tiě méi zhuāngjìnqù , tā biàn jiāng nà kuài xiàng dùn de bǎn ná qǐ yòu fàngxià .
pairs.english: She had come to ask the day before whether she could see the empty wooden carriers; Instructor Vey had agreed to spare a little time, and with no iron fitted she lifted and lowered that shieldlike board.
pairs.hanzi: 她前一天来问过能不能看空木托，维老师答应留一小段工夫，铁没装进去，她便将那块像盾的板拿起又放下。

pairs.target: " zhèbiān zhēn bǐ wǒ huà de hòu . "
pairs.english: “This side really is thicker than I drew it.”
pairs.hanzi: “这边真比我画的厚。”

pairs.target: tā jiāng zhǐ zhuǎngěi tǎ wéi , tā kàn le yìyǎn , fāxiànzìjǐ píng jìyì huà de nà zhī wòbǎ , jīhū ràng shǒuzhǐ chuān jìn le cèbǎn lǐ .
pairs.english: She turned the paper toward Tavi; he took one look and found that the grip he had drawn from memory almost sent his fingers through the side board.
pairs.hanzi: 她将纸转给塔维，他看了一眼，发现自己凭记忆画的那只握把，几乎让手指穿进了侧板里。

pairs.target: sòng yuǎn méiyǒu xiào tā , bǎ liǎngzhī kōng mù tuōjiāo guòlái , jiào tā xiān fú zhe , zài diàn le bù de ǎi zhuōshàng táiqǐ yìdiǎn , bú màibù , yě búyòng dǎng shénme .
pairs.english: Song Yuan did not laugh at him, handing over both empty wooden carriers and telling him first to support them and lift a little above the low cloth-padded table, without stepping or blocking anything.
pairs.hanzi: 宋远没有笑他，把两只空木托交过来，叫他先扶着，在垫了布的矮桌上抬起一点，不迈步，也不用挡什么。

pairs.target: mù tuō yì lí zhuō , tǎ wéi biàn bǎ gēbo wǎng lǐ jiā , zuǒbiān bǎn yán jǐ dào yòushǒu , tā xiǎng cuòkāi , liǎngzhīshǒu què yuètiáo yuè bièniu .
pairs.english: As soon as the carriers left the table, Tavi then clamped his arms inward; the left board edge pressed into his right hand, and he tried to offset them, yet the more he adjusted, the more awkward both hands became.
pairs.hanzi: 木托一离桌，塔维便把胳膊往里夹，左边板沿挤到右手，他想错开，两只手却越调越别扭。

pairs.target: mǐlā zhàn zài pángbiān kàn , zuǐchún dòng le yíxià , méi xiān zhǐ , tǎ wéi tái yǎn wèn tā kànjiàn shénme , tā cái zài zìjǐ de zhǐ shàng bǎ liǎngchù chóngdié de biān quān chūlái .
pairs.english: Mira watched from beside him, her lips moving briefly, without pointing first; Tavi looked up and asked what she saw, and only then did she circle the two overlapping edges on her own paper.
pairs.hanzi: 米拉站在旁边看，嘴唇动了一下，没先指，塔维抬眼问她看见什么，她才在自己的纸上把两处重叠的边圈出来。

pairs.target: tā shuō zìjǐ de kuàng yě shì , huà de shíhòu měiyíchù dōu néng chāi , rén de liǎngzhīshǒu fàngjìnqù , cái fāxiàn zhōngjiān gēnběn méiyǒu liǎngzhīshǒu de dìfāng .
pairs.english: She said her frame was the same: on paper every part could come apart, but only after putting human hands inside did one discover there was simply no room for two hands in the middle.
pairs.hanzi: 她说自己的框也是，画的时候每一处都能拆，人的两只手放进去，才发现中间根本没有两只手的地方。

pairs.target: sòng yuǎn kàn le yìzhī mù tuō de wòbǎ , xiān ràng tǎ wéi bǎ dōngxī fàng huí zhuōshàng , děng tā shǒu sōngkāi , cái zhuǎn le gè fāngxiàng , jiāng xiàngpèng de dìfāng nuó yuǎn .
pairs.english: Song Yuan inspected one wooden carrier's grip and first had Tavi put the objects back on the table, waiting for his hands to release before changing its orientation and moving the colliding parts farther apart.
pairs.hanzi: 宋远看了一只木托的握把，先让塔维把东西放回桌上，等他手松开，才转了个方向，将相碰的地方挪远。

pairs.target: tǎ wéi zhèhuí néng jiāng tāmen tái kāi yìdiǎn , gēbo què fāchàn , liǎnggè kōng dōngxī bìng bú zhòng , guàdào zìjǐ shǒushàng biàn búshì zhuōshàng de yàngzi .
pairs.english: This time Tavi could lift them clear a little, but his arms trembled; both empty objects were not heavy, yet once hanging from his own hands they did not look the same as on the table.
pairs.hanzi: 塔维这回能将它们抬开一点，胳膊却发颤，两个空东西并不重，挂到自己手上便不是桌上的样子。

pairs.target: tā xiǎng rěn zhe , mǐlā xiān shuō tā yě xiǎng shì , sòng yuǎn kàn tā , děng tā diǎntóu , cái ràng tā fàngxià , bǎ kōng mù tuō dì dào lìngyìbiān .
pairs.english: He wanted to endure it; Mira first said she wanted a try too, and Song Yuan looked at him, waiting for his nod before letting him put them down and pass the empty carriers to the other side.
pairs.hanzi: 他想忍着，米拉先说她也想试，宋远看他，等他点头，才让他放下，把空木托递到另一边。

pairs.target: tā de shǒu bǐ tā wěn xiē , zuǒbiān què yě wǎng lǐ shōu , jǐ xī hòu biàn jiāng dōngxī gēxià , zhòuméi shuō zìjǐ fāngcái huàzhǐ shí , hái yǐwéi shǒuwàn nénggòu suíbiàn zhuǎn .
pairs.english: Her hands were steadier than his, but the left too drew inward; after a few breaths she put the objects down, frowning and saying that while drawing earlier she had thought wrists could turn however they pleased.
pairs.hanzi: 她的手比他稳些，左边却也往里收，几息后便将东西搁下，皱眉说自己方才画纸时，还以为手腕能够随便转。

pairs.target: " mùtou méi tīng zhǐ de . "
pairs.english: “The wood did not listen to the paper.”
pairs.hanzi: “木头没听纸的。”

pairs.target: tǎ wéi shuō , tā kàn tā yìyǎn , shuō zhǐ yě méi dāying guò , tā búbì tì tā rèncuò .
pairs.english: Tavi said; she gave him one glance and said the paper had never promised either, so he need not apologize for it.
pairs.hanzi: 塔维说，她看他一眼，说纸也没答应过，他不必替它认错。

pairs.target: liǎnggè rén xiào guò , mǐlā bǎ xīn de biānxiàn bǔ hǎo , lǎoshī zài wàitou jiào tā , tā xiān wèn tǎ wéi wǎnxiē yǒuméiyǒu kōng , bǎ chāo dào yíbàn de cè tiáo túhuà wán .
pairs.english: Both laughed, Mira filled in the new edge lines; the instructor called her outside, and she first asked whether Tavi was free later to finish the half-copied side-strip drawing.
pairs.hanzi: 两个人笑过，米拉把新的边线补好，老师在外头叫她，她先问塔维晚些有没有空，把抄到一半的侧条图画完。

pairs.target: tā dāying qù , méi shuō děng zìjǐ liàn dào mǎnyì wéizhǐ , tā jiāng zhǐ zhé hǎo zǒu le , ménwài bào mù de shēngyīn yòu jiēzhe xiǎng qǐlái .
pairs.english: He agreed to come, not saying he would wait until his practice satisfied him; she folded the paper and left, and the sound of planing outside resumed again.
pairs.hanzi: 他答应去，没说等自己练到满意为止，她将纸折好走了，门外刨木的声音又接着响起来。

pairs.target: wéi lǎoshī zhè cái nálái yuánxiān liǎngpiàn tiě , jiào tā réng fàng huí zhuōshàng de jiù wèizhì , xiānchá zhěngpiàn dàxiǎo , kèxiàn , zài guà tóngyàng de xiǎo zàihè , dǎng piàn méi dòng , mù tuō xià lìng jì le duǎnshéng , líkāi bù diàn yě luò bùyuǎn .
pairs.english: Only then did Instructor Vey bring the original two iron pieces and tell him still to return them to the old positions on the table, first checking whole size and marks, then hanging the same small loads; the stops stayed unchanged, with short cords additionally tied beneath the carriers so they could not fall far even clear of the padding.
pairs.hanzi: 维老师这才拿来原先两片铁，叫他仍放回桌上的旧位置，先查整片大小、刻线，再挂同样的小载荷，挡片没动，木托下另系了短绳，离开布垫也落不远。

pairs.target: sòng yuǎn wèn jīnrì yào buyào shùnzhe shì ná , tā shuō xiān kàn bú jiè xìng shí de dúshù , huàn le shǒu tuō zhe , shǒu zìjǐ de fènliang yě huì jìnlái , bùnéng ràng tā píng juéde wěnbiàn suàn .
pairs.english: Song Yuan asked whether to try holding them today; she said first to examine the readings without borrowing properties: once hands did the supporting, their own weight entered too, and he could not count it merely because it felt steady.
pairs.hanzi: 宋远问今日要不要顺着试拿，她说先看不借性时的读数，换了手托着，手自己的分量也会进来，不能让他凭觉得稳便算。

pairs.target: tǎ wéi shuāng zhǎng tiē hǎo , ànshuō dìng de fǎzi shì tái , mùpiàn shàng de jìhào xiān dòng le , yòubiān de dòngzuò bǐ zuǒbiān dà , tā chàdiǎn biàn shuō yòubiān tài duō .
pairs.english: Tavi made contact with both palms and tried lifting by the agreed method; the wooden indicators' marks moved first, the right moving farther than the left, and he almost said the right was too much.
pairs.hanzi: 塔维双掌贴好，按说定的法子试抬，木片上的记号先动了，右边的动作比左边大，他差点便说右边太多。

pairs.target: kě tā méiyǒu jiè xìng , huà tíng zài zuǐlǐ , tā jiāng liǎngbiān fàng huíqù , děng xiǎo yā mù búzài huàng , cái wèn zìjǐ shìbushì lián pǔtōng de yě hái méi kàn míngbái .
pairs.english: But he had not borrowed properties; the words stopped in his mouth, and he set both sides back, waiting for the loading blocks to stop swaying before asking whether he still had not understood even the ordinary response.
pairs.hanzi: 可他没有借性，话停在嘴里，他将两边放回去，等小压木不再晃，才问自己是不是连普通的也还没看明白。

pairs.target: wéi lǎoshī ràng tā zuòxià kàn zìjǐ tái tóngyí fù mù tuō , jìhào yě nuó le , huàn gè tái fǎ , nuó de dìfāng yòu bùtóng , tiě méiyǒu yīncǐ biànchéng biéde tiě .
pairs.english: Instructor Vey had him sit and watch her lift the same carriers; the marks moved too, and a different lift shifted them differently again; the iron had not therefore become different iron.
pairs.hanzi: 维老师让他坐下看自己抬同一副木托，记号也挪了，换个抬法，挪的地方又不同，铁没有因此变成别的铁。

pairs.target: sòng yuǎn shuō ná zài shǒulǐ búshì ràng zhuōzi gēnzhe zìjǐ zǒu , biàn jiāng bù diàn zhé gāo xiē , gěi liǎngzhīshǒu liúxià néng tíngzhù de dìfāng , bú jiào tā xuán zhe rěn .
pairs.english: Song Yuan said holding things did not mean making the table go along with you; he then folded the padding higher, leaving a place for both hands to rest rather than making him endure with them suspended.
pairs.hanzi: 宋远说拿在手里不是让桌子跟着自己走，便将布垫折高些，给两只手留下能停住的地方，不叫他悬着忍。

pairs.target: zhèhuí tǎ wéi xiān bù tái , zhǐ jiāng mù tuō de fènliang mànmàn jiēguò lái , zhuōmiàn réng zài xià tóu , liǎngbiān de pǔtōng fǎnyìng zhōngyú búzài yízhèn yuǎn yízhèn jìn .
pairs.english: This time Tavi did not lift first, only slowly taking the carriers' weight while the table remained underneath; at last the two sides' ordinary responses stopped drifting near and far.
pairs.hanzi: 这回塔维先不抬，只将木托的分量慢慢接过来，桌面仍在下头，两边的普通反应终于不再一阵远一阵近。

pairs.target: tā kàn le hěn jiǔ , zhídào néng xiān shuōchū nǎ piàn mùpiàn huì dòng , cái shì zhe jiē nà yìdiǎn chābié , què yīn yòuwàn yì zhuǎn , xiān jiāng biànhuà shōuhuí .
pairs.english: He watched a long time, until he could say beforehand which wooden indicator would move, before trying to establish that slight difference; when his right wrist turned, however, he first canceled the change.
pairs.hanzi: 他看了很久，直到能先说出哪片木片会动，才试着接那一点差别，却因右腕一转，先将变化收回。

pairs.target: shuāngshǒu tiēzhe shōuhuí hòu , réng àn lǎo fǎ chá liǎngbiān , fàngsōng , xièzài , wéi lǎoshī wèn guò shǒuzhǐ de gǎnjué , méiyǒu tì tā xiěchéng shībài , yě méiyǒu xiěchéng yǐjīng huì ná .
pairs.english: After canceling with both hands touching, he still checked both sides by the old method, relaxed and unloaded; Instructor Vey asked about his finger sensation, and neither recorded a failure for him nor recorded that he could already hold the setup.
pairs.hanzi: 双手贴着收回后，仍按老法查两边，放松、卸载，维老师问过手指的感觉，没有替他写成失败，也没有写成已经会拿。

pairs.target: tǎ wéi zìjǐ xiěxià yòushǒu zhuǎn le , sòng yuǎn zhàn zài tā hòutou , kàn tā xiě wán , wèn zhè jǐgè zì dǎsuàn wǎng nǎér fàng , tā shuō fàngdào xiàhuí dìyīháng .
pairs.english: Tavi himself wrote right hand turned; Song Yuan stood at his back, watched him finish and asked where he meant to put those words; he said on the next session's first line.
pairs.hanzi: 塔维自己写下右手转了，宋远站在他后头，看他写完，问这几个字打算往哪儿放，他说放到下回第一行。

pairs.target: zǒushí tā jiāng tiě liúzài wéi lǎoshī shǒubiān , qù mùgōng fáng zhǎo mǐlā , ménkǒu bǎi zhe nà zhī shī guò de kuàng , mù jiǎo chāi xiàdān fàng , tā jiāng ménbiān de shībù dā huí jiàshàng , cái tuī mén jìnqù .
pairs.english: Leaving, he left the iron within Instructor Vey's reach and went to find Mira in the woodshop; the once-wet frame stood by the door, its wooden corner removed and set apart; he hung the wet cloth from the doorway back on the rack before pushing the door open.
pairs.hanzi: 走时他将铁留在维老师手边，去木工房找米拉，门口摆着那只湿过的框，木角拆下单放，他将门边的湿布搭回架上，才推门进去。

pairs.target: mǐlā táitóu shuō hái yǐwéi tā yào děngdào wǎnfàn qián cái lái , tā jiāng dèngzi tuō dào zhuōbiān , wèn tā nà yídào xiéxiàn zhèhuí kěnbukěn ràng rén kàn míngbái , tā bǎ tàn tóu dì lái , jiào tā xiān huà .
pairs.english: Mira looked up and said she had expected him to wait until just before supper before coming; he dragged a stool to the table and asked her whether that diagonal would let people understand it this time; she handed over the charcoal and told him to draw first.
pairs.hanzi: 米拉抬头说还以为他要等到晚饭前才来，他将凳子拖到桌边，问她那一道斜线这回肯不肯让人看明白，她把炭头递来，叫他先画。
